title: feat(plk14): plane-hug same-k fails at k=14: t=26 vs t=46
science: Defines plane-hug pi = mu + cost 3 on any 3->3 hop whose dest has min|w_i|=1; on B_42 t(14,0,0)=26, t(14,14,14)=46, identical to the rho3 wall pair. Runner proves pi is not a rho3/mu leftover by pricing (2,2,1)->(3,2,1) at 3 where both parents price 1, yet the arrivals are unchanged: another live-but-idle clause.
